name: qrcode-barcode-scanner
description: Read QR codes and barcodes in local images with the QR Code & Barcode Scanner skill and its pinned local MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Read QR codes, product barcodes and matrix codes from local images. The plugin adds the QR Code & Barcode Scanner skill, which runs a small helper on an image file, and a local MCP server pinned to version 0.3.1, which scans image bytes. Both return the engine's unchanged JSON report: the exact payload bytes, the format of each code and, for QR codes, a scannability judgment. Scanning runs on your computer. Decoded text is untrusted data.
defaultPrompt: Read the QR code and the barcode in this image
